sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Chester Selectboard members: Lauren Fierman, A Lee Gustafson (Chair), Peter Hudkins, Arne Jonynas, and Timothy Roper.

Town of Chester official website, Select Board page: lists Lee Gustafson (Chair), Arunas 'Arne' Jonynas (Vice Chair), Tim Roper, Peter Hudkins, and Lauren Fierman. The directory forms recorded here are A Lee Gustafson, Arne Jonynas, and Timothy Roper.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Amie Record as Town Clerk of Chester and as Town Treasurer of Chester.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Amie Record as Town Clerk of Chester and as Town Treasurer of Chester.

Town of Chester official website, 'Elective Offices' post: the town's elective offices include a Town Moderator, one-year term. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Chester official website, 'Elective Offices' post: the town's elective offices include a Town Grand Juror, one-year term. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Chester official website, 'Elective Offices' post: the town's elective offices include an Agent to Defend Suits, one-year term -- the town agent under the styling Chester's elective-offices post uses. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Chester official website, 'Elective Offices' post: the town's elective offices include Trustees of Public Funds, one three-year seat elected each year. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Chester justices of the peace: Kenneth D. Barrett, Patricia Budnick, Heather Chase, Lisa Duncan, Gerald Gleason, Edward Grossman, Jessica Krust, Cheryl LeClair, Marilyn Mahusky, Russell Monier, Larry Semones, and Sarah Vail. Heather Chase is a distinct person from Chelsea Town Clerk Jennifer Chase and Chelsea Selectboard member Curtis Chase.
